E X E C U T I V E S U M M A RY
Information is your enterprise's
most valuable asset. Govern it.
Govern it.
Every strategic decision, regulatory submission,
contract, product release and customer interaction
depends on documents. Yet in most organisations,
that content is scattered across file shares, inboxes,
legacy systems and paper archives — slowing work,
multiplying risk and hiding value.
SmartiDP EDMS unifies the complete document
lifecycle on one secure, intelligent platform. AI-driven
capture turns unstructured content into structured,
searchable information. Configurable workflows
automate reviews, approvals and records
management. Security and compliance controls are
built into every layer — so your organisation can
move faster and stay audit-ready.
One platform. Every document. Complete
control — from the moment content is created to
the day it is defensibly disposed of.
